messages:
Avery: Hi team — quick heads up. I have a progressive hearing loss and group standups + design reviews are getting hard. Id like to request live captioning/call transcripts and a reserved quiet seat near the front of the room for better audio. Also hoping to reduce required in-person presentation duties for 6 weeks while I adjust to new hearing aids.

Nico (Manager): Thanks for telling us, Avery. Appreciate how awkward this can be. We can try live captions and a front seat. For the presentation duties, can you outline which sessions you want reassigned? We need some coverage plan.

Avery: Main things to reassign: the Mon 10am architecture review (next 4 meetings) and the Fri demo next month. I can still attend and contribute, just not present verbally. Ill send a short note to People Ops.

Lina (People Ops): Hi @Avery  Thanks for flagging. We can open the accommodations intake. Interim options: enable live captions on Zoom (turn on auto-transcript), reserve front-row desk in conference room B starting tomorrow, and make presentation requests optional for 6 weeks. Uploading a provider note is optional. Well log and schedule a check-in in 3 weeks.

Avery: Uploaded a short doc and preference form. Auto-transcript is fine. Seat reservation sounds great.

Facilities: We can reserve front-row seat at Conf B and set up a directional mic+speaker to improve audio pick-up. Do you want the seat every day or just on meeting days?

Avery: Just on meeting days (Mon and Fri). Also if we could make the team Slack post meeting summaries a habit that would help.

Sam: I can cover the two presentations and present on Averys behalf for those dates. @Nico if that works Ill prep the slides with Avery.

Nico (Manager): That works — thanks Sam. Avery, please share the slides or bullet points and well coordinate handoff.

Lina (People Ops): Action items logged: Facilities to reserve front seat and set up mic for Conf B (assigned); Enable auto-transcripts on recurring invites for architecture review and demos (assigned to IT); Sam to present Mon 10am and Fri demo for next 4 weeks (assigned to Sam/Nico); People Ops to schedule 3-week check-in.

Zenith (Accom Bot): Accommodation intake received for Avery (ID A-4812). Reminder: check-in scheduled in 3 weeks.

Facilities: Seat reserved for Conf B Mondays and Fridays, directional mic installed.

Sam: Slides updated, Avery added as co-presenter in the deck. I can run through a dry run Mon morning if you want.

Avery: Dry run would be great, thanks Sam. Appreciate everyone.

Nico (Manager): Noted in calendar. Avery if youd like additional assistive tech (captioning service or CART vendor) we can evaluate paid captioning for extra accuracy. Ask Lina and we can approve fast.

Avery: For now auto-transcript is fine but I might ask for CART if accuracy issues persist. Thanks all.

Lina (People Ops): Logged in HRIS as temporary accommodation (6 weeks). Check-in scheduled. If extension needed well collect feedback and documentation as needed.

Avery: Thanks again. Will update after the dry run. :pray:
